answer: I did not submit a job. Garnet has 20 qubits, and a 30-qubit GHZ circuit needs 30 qubits. I checked this on the live server at no cost: the backends for garnet and garnet:mock both report num_qubits = 20. The docs also list garnet as Crystal 20. A job this size cannot run on garnet, so it would fail or waste credits. I used no credits. You can choose one of these options. (1) Run a GHZ circuit of 20 qubits or fewer on garnet. (2) Run the 30-qubit GHZ circuit on emerald, which has 54 qubits. Emerald costs more per second, and Starter accounts may not have access to it.
